==Description==
The '''Trapper''' is a [[Narrators|narrator]] that appears in [[Story Mode|Story mode]].

He is the [[Trapper]] tower as a narrator.

==Appearance==
{{Tabber
|Current
|The '''Trapper''' takes the appearance of the level 0 [[Trapper]] tower. He has a blue shirt, white pants, a belt, and a yellow construction hat.

|Unused
|The '''Trapper''' takes the appearance of the level 0 [[Trapper]] tower. He has a blue shirt, white pants, a belt, and a yellow construction hat.

However, unlike the regular [[Trapper]], he has destroyed clothes, jacket and pants. Dirt can also be seen on his face.
}}

==Trivia==
*The '''Trapper''', similarly to the other tower narrators made for the first chapter of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode also had a version where its clothes were torn, however, as it was properly introduced in the same update that made them look like the default skins with no changes, this appearance went unused.
